fuente.titulo: Bishop Ignatius Ding Zuyao ordained in Haimen, China

titular: Bishop ordained in China under Vatican accord
bajada: Ignatius Ding Zuyao consecrated in Haimen following Pope Leo XIV's appointment
caption: Bishop Ignatius Ding Zuyao was ordained in Haimen, Jiangsu Province, after being appointed by Pope Leo XIV under the Provisional Agreement between the Holy See and China. Source: Vatican News, Oct 15, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A traditional Chinese cathedral exterior with soft morning light; a bishop in vestments stands at the entrance, shown from behind at mid-distance in the upper right third, left and center open
